🚨 *new alert — needs human*  (score: 8)
Channel: alert-frontend... no — *alert-system*  •  bug-type guess: unknown (likely code/data — transient exception on REST tables-read path)  •  alerts in group: 3
Owning team (would tag — not tagged): `Vertical App Experience` (`@sales management` / `#team-sales-management`)

Symptoms:
  - Monitor 70171778 "Unexpected number of 5XX errors" tripped 11:17–11:24Z, self-recovered (OK 11:24:38Z).
  - **90 × HTTP 500** on `rest-api` (runtime-core public REST host), all on one endpoint: `GET /api/v{version}/tables/{table}`. Error rate ≈ 0.51% of 17,818 hits; peak rolling-5min ≈ 82 vs threshold 30.
  - ⚠️ *2nd identical occurrence* — 2026-06-16 (`cb96c9950d20bb7d`) was 75×500 on the SAME endpoint, same monitor, same self-recovery.

Trace IDs: n/a — these 500s are APM-only (not in Serilog); see DD APM traces link below.
Likely cause: transient SQL/app exception on the per-tenant table-read path; brief and self-recovered. Exact exception *undetermined* — not written to Serilog/ES (ES is back up, 17-day 401 resolved, but this signature is APM-only) and traces carry no `@account_name`.
Suggested next action: **file a defect** against the runtime-core REST `GET tables/{table}` handler (the 06-16 follow-up said "if it recurs, file a defect" — it has). Recommend adding a Serilog Error write (account + exception) on that catch path so the next occurrence is diagnosable + auto-classifiable. Consider seeding a recurrence-tracking KI (proposed in the investigation report).
